domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 研究信号时间与频率联合特征的方法。
usage_overview: 用于识别轨道不平顺或轮轨力信号的局部频率特征，并确定其出现位置或时刻，支持不平顺特征波长、病害波形及局部冲击的定位。处理沿线轨道数据时，以里程作为位置坐标。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: In this model, the vehicle–track interactions considering the nonlinear wheel–rail contact geometries are depicted in three-dimensional (3D) space, and then the approaches for global sensitivity analysis (GSA) and time–frequency analysis are combined with the dynamic model.
Moreover, an advanced time–frequency analysis approach will be introduced to capture the sensitive features of track irregularities contributing significantly to the vehicle–track interactions.
